result.instructions: Tools for Members.dev, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which members have an overdue invoice right now?"; "How many active subscriptions do we have for each membership product?"; "Who is booked into next week's events, and who is on the waitlist?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Members.dev data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run membersdev_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run membersdev_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run membersdev_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. membersdev_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: membersdev_get_account
tools.title: Get current account
tools.description: Get the account that owns the API key (id, email, role, organizations). Members.dev API: GET /v1/accounts/me.

tools.name: membersdev_list_organizations
tools.title: List organizations
tools.description: List the organizations (venues, clubs) the key can reach. Use an organization id as the optional 'Organization id' at login to scope the key. GET /v1/organizations.

tools.name: membersdev_list_members
tools.title: List members
tools.description: List and search members. Filter by text search, email, external id, status, group or product. Newest first by default. GET /v1/members.

search.description: Free-text search over name and email.

external_id.description: Your own id stored on the member.

group_id.description: Only members in these group ids.

product_id.description: Only members with these membership product ids.

account_id.description: Only members linked to this account id.

tools.name: membersdev_get_member
tools.title: Get member
tools.description: Get one member with subscriptions, groups and custom fields. GET /v1/members/{member_id}.

tools.name: membersdev_get_member_by_external_id
tools.title: Get member by external id
tools.description: Get one member by the external id you stored. GET /v1/members/external/{external_id}.

tools.name: membersdev_list_products
tools.title: List membership products
tools.description: List membership products (plans) with price, billing period and status. GET /v1/products.

tools.name: membersdev_get_product
tools.title: Get membership product
tools.description: Get one membership product. GET /v1/products/{product_id}.

tools.name: membersdev_list_subscriptions
tools.title: List subscriptions
tools.description: List member subscriptions with status, period dates and product. GET /v1/subscriptions.

tools.name: membersdev_get_subscription
tools.title: Get subscription
tools.description: Get one subscription with invoices, credit notes and billing periods. GET /v1/subscriptions/{subscription_id}.

tools.name: membersdev_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List events and classes in a time window. Use single_events to expand recurring events. GET /v1/events.

single_events.description: Expand recurring events into single occurrences.

hosts.description: Only events with these host ids.

tools.name: membersdev_get_event
tools.title: Get event
tools.description: Get one event. GET /v1/events/{event_id}.

tools.name: membersdev_list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: List event bookings, filtered by member, event, status or time. GET /v1/bookings.

tools.name: membersdev_get_booking
tools.title: Get booking
tools.description: Get one booking. GET /v1/bookings/{event_booking_id}.

tools.name: membersdev_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices, filtered by status, member or subscription. Amounts are in the smallest currency unit. GET /v1/invoices.

tools.name: membersdev_get_invoice
tools.title: Get invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice with its lines and payment allocations. GET /v1/invoices/{invoice_id}.

tools.name: membersdev_list_payments
tools.title: List payments
tools.description: List payments, filtered by member, status or invoice. GET /v1/payments.

tools.name: membersdev_list_credit_notes
tools.title: List credit notes
tools.description: List credit notes, filtered by member or subscription. GET /v1/credit-notes.

tools.name: membersdev_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List member groups. GET /v1/groups.

tools.name: membersdev_list_benefits
tools.title: List benefits
tools.description: List benefits (entitlements) that products can grant. GET /v1/benefits.

tools.name: membersdev_list_benefit_grants
tools.title: List benefit grants
tools.description: List benefit grants (what each member holds and has left). GET /v1/grants.

tools.name: membersdev_list_guests
tools.title: List guests
tools.description: List guest registrations, filtered by status or host member. GET /v1/guests.

member_id.description: Only guests of these member ids.

tools.name: membersdev_create_member
tools.title: Create member
tools.description: WRITE: create a new member record. Does not charge anyone or send an invite. Creating twice makes two members, so check with membersdev_list_members first. POST /v1/members.

external_id.description: Your own unique id for the member.

phone.description: Phone object as the API defines it (MemberPhoneInput).

address.description: Address object as the API defines it (AddressInput).

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by field key.

tools.name: membersdev_update_member
tools.title: Update member
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing member (only the fields you pass). Setting status to archived or rejected changes the member's access. Repeating the same call has the same result. PATCH /v1/members/{member_id}.

phone.description: Phone object as the API defines it (MemberPhoneInput).

address.description: Address object as the API defines it (AddressInput).

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by field key.
